ops.html:
Clinical Pearls:

  • Edema can cause halos in the vision.
  • Bilateral disc swelling and any suspected mass require imaging.

nodes.t: Perform slit-lamp exam to localize: Left → Right on scheme
Lens — obscure red reflex, poor fundus visibility
nodes.d:
Obscure Red Reflex, Poor fundus Visibility

  • Cataract (Nuclear, Subcapsular, Cortical)

Drusen or Edema

  • Age Related Macular Degeneration (Wet, Dry)

nodes.t: Retina — cotton wool spots, micro-aneurysms, hemorrhage, macular edema
nodes.d:
Cotton wool spots, Micro-aneurysms, Hemorrhage and Macular Edema

  • Diabetic Retinopathy (Background, Pre-Proliferative, Proliferative)
  • Retinitis Pigmentosa (Decreased night vision, loss of peripheral vision)
  • Systemic inflammatory conditions

nodes.t: Optic Nerve — pallor, papilledema, irregular disc, large cup:disc
Optic Track — visual field defects, decreased color vision
nodes.d:
Visual field defects, decrease in color vision

  • Optic Nerve Compression
  • Pituitary Lesion
  • Meningioma
  • Craniopharyngioma
